title: Extreme eigenvalues and eigenvectors for finite rank additive deformations of non-hermitian sparse random matrices
summary: Consider a $n\times n$ sparse non-Hermitian random matrix $X_n$ defined as the Hadamard product between a random matrix with centered independent and identically distributed entries and a sparse Bernoulli matrix with success probability $K_n/n$ where $K_n\le n$ (and possibly $K_n\ll n$) and $K_n\to \infty$ as $n\to \infty$. Let $E_n$ be a deterministic $n\times n$ finite-rank matrix. We prove that the outlier eigenvalues of $Y_n= X_n +E_n$ asymptotically match those of $E_n$.
